steps.title: Your files deserve more than a hard drive
steps.text: A laptop can break. A phone can get lost. The cloud keeps your files everywhere you need them, on any device, at any time.

steps.title: Because simple should taste like mango
steps.text: One rule guided Mango Cloud: if a step doesn't help you, it goes. Clean interface, instant upload, no hidden menus.

steps.title: Three problems, solved at once
steps.text: Lost or overwritten files. Slow syncing across devices. Messy collaboration. Mango Cloud closes all three with automatic backup, real-time sync, and clear sharing permissions.
